notes.title: Our First Update: QOL, Meta-progression & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a few days since we launched the game, and we have been working hard to improve it based on the feedback you've provided.

In this initial update, we concentrated on two main areas: improving QOL and adjusting the balance of meta-progression. Additionally, we have addressed and fixed the bugs you reported.

Also, we are working on some new game content for the next big update!

GAMEPLAY

Reduced the Energy collected by Spiders.
Reduced the chance of unlocking a Legendary Component.
Decreased the invulnerability duration of the Dash Surge Augmentation Overload from 1 to 0.7 seconds.
Added a cap to the minimum dash cooldown at 1 second.
Increased the number of elimination needed to activate the Berserk power-up from 25 to 40.
The Gravity Blaster Core can now reload, allowing it to interact with on-reload power-ups.
Increased the Pickup Range of the Magnet Augmentation from +10/20/30/40% to 20/40/60/100%.
Decreased the chance of activating the Magnet Augmentation Overload from 100% to 65%.
Added a new chest type that drops a Magnet, collecting all experience on the ground.
Unlocking the Adversity Protocol on a map for the first time now unlocks it for all cores.
Balanced the achievements to smooth out game progression.


QOL

Added dithering to clarify when an object is between the player and the camera.
A tooltip appears when a Core must first be unlocked by a specific achievement.
Added details of passive bonuses to the Destiny Holder window.
Decreased the volume of the Echothrust Ability audio.


BUGFIXES

Fixed a runtime error caused by the Ice Pierce power-up.
Fixed a bug that prevented the collection of end-game statistics for Furyblade.
Fixed a bug where using the Seeker Launcher core would cause the game to soft-lock.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from collecting the Mythril at the end of a game.
Fixed a bug where excessive dash cooldown reduction locked the dash.
Fixed a bug where excessive movement speed reduction locked movement.
Fixed a bug where the game's resolution was incorrectly set.
Fixed a bug causing the game to crash during gameplay.


JOIN DISCORD
If you have any suggestions or would like to engage in a conversation, feel free to join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/ep4t93D93p


- Hubber Studios

We've been listening to your feedback, so this is little patch before the Next Fest! 
Thanks for helping us :D

BUG FIXES

Fixed a bug where Gravity Blaster stopped working after resurrecting.
Fixed a bug where Explosive Droids would not explode.
Fixed a bug where Dual Explosives would not spawn 2 Explosive Droids.
Fixed a bug where sometimes, at the start of a run, enemies would not spawn if you are not moving.

notes.title: Our First Update: How We Improved the Game Demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
It's been a few weeks since we released the demo and we have been working hard to improve the game based on your feedback.

In this first update, we've focused on two key areas: accessibility and gameplay. We've put a lot of effort into improving your DPS. We've also made boss fights and enemies more balanced, so the game won't be unnecessarily punishing.

We've got exciting plans for future updates too. We're looking to add new maps, weapons, and power-up trees, so there will be even more to explore and discover in the demo.

We want to be transparent with you, so we'll keep you updated on all the changes we make to the game right here. If it gets too long-winded (let us know), we'll find another way to share all the details with you. 
Stay tuned!
